The Los Angeles Lakers have won seven straight games! Watch the best plays from the win streak.
The Lakers most recently beat the Bucks, 123-112, and have outscored opponents by more than 10 points per game during the stretch, scoring 125.3 points and allowing 115 on average. Luka Dončić has led the way, and he has also recorded 30+ points, 5+ rebounds and 5+ assists in nine straight games, tying the NBA record.
